eligibility.scope: Prior published model transferred to the newly authorized NC2099 affinity benchmark

Root must attach matching historic task/run IDs once registered. Existing expired clocks/restrictions remain intact.
excluded_claims: No claim to reproduce original paper tables on the changed dataset
